fallback_policy: NONE — do not silently substitute fictional constants. Display 'Historical environmental forcing not loaded' if either dataset is absent.
notes: The existing analytics.py particle_backtrack function uses hardcoded wind/current constants. Those constants are labelled ILLUSTRATIVE and are acceptable for the training sandbox. They must NOT be used for the SIH-ENNORE-2017 canonical case without real data.
